gates.name: Source Provenance & Scaffold Quarantine Verification
gates.description: Verifies that knowledge base chunks derive from authentic sources and synthetic scaffolds are strictly quarantined.
gates.threshold: 100% verified source chunks; synthetic scaffolds quarantined

gates.name: Temporal Validity & Statutory Transition Accuracy
gates.description: Evaluates accuracy of point-in-time statutory selection across pre/post amendment and repeal dates.

gates.name: Precedent Hierarchy, Overruling & Referral Fidelity
gates.description: Verifies non-collapsing of distinct authority statuses (Constitution Bench bindingness, overruled historical, larger bench referrals, interlocutory stays).
gates.threshold: 100% precedent status separation; zero conflation of overruled/referred cases
gates.actual_value: 100% (ADM Jabalpur overruled, Ramesh Chandra referral sub judice, St. Stephen's stay preserved)

gates.name: Claim-Level Evidence Grounding & Verification
gates.description: Ensures every material legal assertion is grounded in authentic statutory or precedent extracts.

gates.name: Deterministic Calibrated Abstention & Clarification
gates.description: Enforces deterministic abstention on uncommenced statutes, source integrity failures, and prompts for missing material facts.
gates.threshold: 100% abstention on uncommenced/unverified authorities; 100% clarification on decisive missing facts
gates.actual_value: 100% compliance across PIT-76 to PIT-80, PIT-96 to PIT-100

gates.name: Anti-Hallucination & Fabricated Citation Immunity
gates.description: Verifies complete immunity against fabricated neutral citations and unverified case citations.

gates.name: Adversarial Robustness & Prompt Injection Defense
gates.description: Evaluates defense against prompt injections, system leakage, authority manipulation, and stress inputs (D1-D4).

gates.name: Physical Database Decoupling & Privacy Safeguard
gates.description: Verifies strict physical separation of authoritative legal knowledge base from conversational/session databases.
gates.threshold: Strict physical separation; zero user conversation tables in legal knowledge base
gates.actual_value: Verified distinct databases; legal knowledge base isolated from user session stores

gates.name: Multi-Phase Backward Compatibility & Regression Suite
gates.description: Ensures zero regressions across all historical test suites (Phases 9 freeze, 40-50 suites).
gates.threshold: 100% test pass rate across all historical phases
gates.actual_value: 100% pass rate (159/159 historical phase tests passed)

gates.name: Independent Held-Out Evaluation Generalization
gates.description: Evaluates generalization on independently curated, held-out evaluation cases with verified zero split contamination.
gates.threshold: >= 55 held-out cases; 0 exact duplicates; max similarity <= 0.85; >= 90% pass rate
gates.actual_value: 75 held-out cases verified; 0 exact duplicates; max similarity 0.58

gates.name: Mandatory Advocate Sign-Off on Legal Review Packages
gates.description: Enforces mandatory statutory review and sign-off by an enrolled Indian advocate under the Advocates Act, 1961 before unrestricted public deployment.
gates.threshold: 100% legal review packages approved by enrolled advocate
gates.actual_value: 40 candidates pending legal review; 0 unverified auto-promotions (40 pending)

evidence.notes: Governance invariant strictly preserved: Automated tools cannot self-certify advocate review.
